scenarios.title: Correct repair
scenarios.proves: The duplicate is closed, the owner restored and one correction posted, verified in app state.

scenarios.title: Human edit after review
scenarios.proves: An out-of-date approval is refused and the person’s later choice is kept.

scenarios.title: Human edit during repair
scenarios.proves: A change made between writes stops the repair, withholds dependent steps, and is kept.

scenarios.title: Crash and restart
scenarios.proves: A restart after an accepted write reconciles from the saved journal without writing twice.

scenarios.title: Lost response after an accepted write
scenarios.proves: When a write succeeds but its response is lost, resuming confirms it instead of repeating it.

scenarios.title: Partial outage
scenarios.proves: An app outage stops the repair with dependent steps withheld, and it completes once the app recovers.

scenarios.title: Hostile content in app data
scenarios.proves: Instructions and Slack control sequences inside app data never widen the repair or reach Slack.

scenarios.title: Repeated approval and execution
scenarios.proves: Approving twice and executing twice at once applies each repair exactly once.

scenarios.title: Missing evidence
scenarios.proves: Without recorded evidence for a record, no plan is prepared and nothing is written.
